title: Sonification & The Problem with Making Music from Data
summary: Tantacrul examines sonification, the practice of turning data into sound or music, and critiques how scientists and musicians, including NASA and CERN projects, use it well and poorly.
why: Recommended as an incisive look at the real potential and common misuse of data sonification, often brought up in threads on space sonifications.

quote.text: Tantacrul has a typically incisive video [1] about the real potential of sonification as a powerful technique for understanding data
